ORGKEY='R00002250' AND PREFERREDFLAG='Y' AND PHONEEMAILTYPE='HOMEPH1' updated
ORGKEY='R00002464' AND PREFERREDFLAG='Y' AND PHONEEMAILTYPE='HOMEPH1' deleted
ORGKEY='R00002223' AND PREFERREDFLAG='Y' AND PHONEEMAILTYPE='HOMEPH1' no change
ORGKEY='99999999'  AND PREFERREDFLAG='Y' AND PHONEEMAILTYPE='HOMEPH1' new record

select * from (
SELECT ORGKEY ORGKEY2,PREFERREDFLAG PREFERREDFLAG2,PHONEEMAILTYPE PHONEEMAILTYPE2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE2,SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE2,* FROM
EDS.CRM_PHONEEMAIL WHERE ORGKEY='R00002250' AND PREFERREDFLAG='Y' AND PHONEEMAILTYPE='HOMEPH1'
UNION ALL
SELECT ORGKEY ORGKEY2,PREFERREDFLAG PREFERREDFLAG2,PHONEEMAILTYPE PHONEEMAILTYPE2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE2,SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE2,* FROM
EDS.CRM_PHONEEMAIL WHERE ORGKEY='R00002464' AND PREFERREDFLAG='Y' AND PHONEEMAILTYPE='HOMEPH1'
UNION ALL
SELECT ORGKEY ORGKEY2,PREFERREDFLAG PREFERREDFLAG2,PHONEEMAILTYPE PHONEEMAILTYPE2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE2,SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE2,* FROM
EDS.CRM_PHONEEMAIL WHERE ORGKEY='R00002223' AND PREFERREDFLAG='Y' AND PHONEEMAILTYPE='HOMEPH1'
UNION ALL
SELECT ORGKEY ORGKEY2,PREFERREDFLAG PREFERREDFLAG2,PHONEEMAILTYPE PHONEEMAILTYPE2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE2,SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE2,* FROM
EDS.CRM_PHONEEMAIL WHERE ORGKEY='99999999' AND PREFERREDFLAG='Y' AND PHONEEMAILTYPE='HOMEPH1'
) temp order by ORGKEY, SCD_START_DATE
